1.d4 g6 2.h4 Nf6.strategy: The natural developing reply: the knight stands in front of the h-pawn's path and joins the g6-pawn in attacking h5, so a push there is not free. Black keeps the usual fianchetto plan and the centre can wait.

1.d4 g6 2.h4 Nf6 3.h5.strategy: Offers a pawn to open the h-file: h5 is attacked by the knight and the g-pawn and defended only by the rook. Black can simply take it with the knight, backed by g6, and White has nothing concrete to show for the pawn.
1.d4 g6 2.h4 Nf6 3.h5.name: Modern Defence: Lizard Defence, Pirc-Diemer Gambit
